title: Scarlet Darkness Copyright Issue & Product Review
description:
This was my experience with Scarlet Darkness. If you'd like to try these items for yourself, see my shopping list below. 

*Below are some affiliate links from Amazon, for which I receive a small commission if you purchase something from my link at no extra cost to you.

My measurements: bust is 38 and a half inches, waist is between 31-33 inches depending on what time I ate, if I'm sucking it in, etc. 

The purple bodice I wore with the pink dress is not Scarlet Darkness brand and runs smaller than SD's stuff.
 The SD bodices run pretty true to size and I got the large, but next time I think I'd try medium since they close all the way before I can cinch them more.

There's a lot of colors to choose from and I'll probably go back for another eventually!
If you want one, you can get it here: https://amzn.to/465h6Ds

The rest of the clothing is all Scarlet Darkness.

Bodice in Wine Floral: https://amzn.to/3Meax8f

Bodice in Green Floral: https://amzn.to/46UhaGs

Chiffon pirate blouse in Sage: https://amzn.to/3SZA6xA

Long bell sleeved dress in wine / red: https://amzn.to/3WTY7Y8
